Claim amendment · seat `domain:ui#4` · `session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T` · 2026-10-27T12:14Z

File surface (replaces the claim's line): `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListViewBlock.tsx`, `ListView.tsx`, `ListViewCompact.tsx`; `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (the `page:tabs` count badge extended to `list-view` descendants only); `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (one count key for 「查看全部 N 条」); tests beside; one root changeset. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/pageRecordActions.ts` is reused unchanged. ⛔ `packages/spec/**`, ⛔ any new authorable key, ⛔ the designer's `BLOCK_CONFIG` (stop on breach; explain in the report)

Clause-②: yes (replaces `no`: the count key widens `@object-ui/i18n`'s published `TranslationKeys`; the seat owes a TIER_DEFAULT declaration review). Metadata-protocol: none (unchanged).

Why: the thread's read-only measurement on origin/main `86ae47e1` found the following.
- The page list block renderer lives in plugin-list, not app-shell: the files objectui#12703 edited for the compact posture and its View all footer.
- `dataSource.limit` is already authorable (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, `ElementDataSourceSchema`). `ListViewBlock` already maps it to `pagination.pageSize`, so no key is added.
- The existing `list.viewAll` carries no count.
- The page designer's block table is hand-curated and has no `list-view` entry. Exposing `limit` there is left out of this card and goes to the report as a follow-up.

Claim amendment · seat `domain:ui#4` · `session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T` · 2026-10-27T12:27Z

File surface (adds to amendment 6441629034):
- `ui/packages/components/src/index.ts`: one barrel export, `usePageTabCountReporter`. `@object-ui/components` is published, so this widens its public surface too. It is covered by the same `Clause-②: yes` declaration review.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/README.md` and `ui/content/docs/guide/react-pages.md`: the compact-posture prose, owed by ui/AGENTS.md #2.
- The two objectui#12703 pins `ListViewBlock.compactRegion-12703` and `compactViewAll-12703`: their wide-region controls are flipped to the capped posture, which is the behaviour this card changes.

Noted for review: a `page:tabs` panel holding a `list-view` is force-mounted hidden, so its count badge exists before the tab opens. Every such tab's list query therefore runs on page load. There is no second count query, so the badge and the rows cannot disagree. The seat weighs that cost at ACCEPT.
